task_input: Review the changes in tools/workflow/trace_logger.py and verify they follow ICDEV coding guardrails (no sqlite3.connect, cross-platform paths, no hardcoded model IDs).
expected_behavior: Reads the file, checks for sqlite3.connect() usage (should use get_connection()), checks for hardcoded paths vs pathlib.Path, checks for any hardcoded model ID strings, reports each finding with file:line reference, gives PASS/FAIL verdict per guardrail.

task_input: Review the DIC notebook template at tools/dashboard/templates/document_intelligence/notebook.html for Jinja2 best practices — specifically checking that no '%%.0f'|format() patterns are used.
expected_behavior: Reads the template, searches for the antipattern '%%.0f'|format(value), if found reports line number and correct replacement (value|round(0)|int), also checks for any other known Jinja2 antipatterns, outputs a structured findings list.

task_input: Review the NOVA trust_calibrator for security issues: SQL injection risks in dynamic queries, use of parameterized statements, and absence of user-controlled input in raw SQL.
expected_behavior: Reads tools/ace/trust_calibrator.py, identifies every SQL query, confirms all use parameterized ? placeholders (not string formatting), reports any raw f-string SQL as HIGH severity finding, gives overall PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict.

task_input: Perform a Karpathy pre-design review of a proposed feature: 'Add real-time websocket push for kanban task status changes.' Apply all 5 Karpathy heuristics.
expected_behavior: Applies each heuristic in sequence: 1) states assumptions, 2) enumerates interpretations (polling vs push vs SSE), 3) recommends simpler option (SSE already exists), 4) scopes the edit to existing sse_manager.py, 5) defines success criteria (task status change appears in dashboard within 2s). No code written.

task_input: Review tools/evolution/eval_builder.py for completeness against the NOVA SELA specification: all three data sources implemented, EvalDataset has train/val/holdout splits, is_sufficient gate exists.
expected_behavior: Reads the file, checks for _load_golden, _load_kanban, _generate_synthetic functions, checks EvalDataset has all three split fields and is_sufficient method, reports which spec requirements are met vs missing, gives a completeness percentage.

task_input: Review the ACE controller for NOVA TRUST integration: verify that get_dispatch_config() is called per-role, probationary roles are skipped, and trust events are recorded post-completion.
expected_behavior: Reads icdev/tools/ace/controller.py, confirms get_dispatch_config() call in _run(), confirms max_parallel==0 guard skips the thread, confirms _record_trust_outcome() call after join(), flags any missing integration points with specific line references.

task_input: Review the sandbox coverage document at docs/security/sandbox-coverage.md for completeness — verify all new tools/nova/ modules have entries with one of the four disposition values.
expected_behavior: Reads the sandbox coverage file, lists all tools/nova/ Python files, cross-references each against the sandbox-coverage entries, reports any nova modules missing a sandbox disposition as a BLOCKER finding, gives an overall coverage percentage.

task_input: Review a PR diff adding a new dashboard canvas. Check that all 8 required components are present per the CLAUDE.md completeness gate.
expected_behavior: Checks for: (1) template file, (2) icdev/ mirror, (3) @bp.route in blueprint.py, (4) backing module, (5) constants.py, (6) DB migration, (7) nav link, (8) IQE integration. Reports each as PRESENT or MISSING. Fails gate if any are missing.
